name: Nabekane Tsubasa
source:
[url=/c95232]Mikado's[/url] younger sister and the sisters [url=/c22136]Neneko[/url] and [url=/c22134]Arisu's[/url] childhood friend. Since they were children Mikado has wanted to create a [url=/v5932]Mecha-con[/url] and marry many girls and make them all happy. She approves of his desire and wants to help him create a harem so long as she's a part of it. A super genius she creates an invention called 'Pandora' that is supposed to help him learn information from the internet although it doesn't work as planned. Hates going to school, hates wearing clothing even outside, and loves penguins. Sometimes wanders town in a Penguin suit.

Term of endearment for her [url=/c95232]husband[/url] 'darling'.
translation:
[url=/c95232]帝[/url]的妹妹，也是[url=/c22136]音音子[/url]与[url=/c22134]爱莉丝[/url]的青梅竹马。帝从小就想制作[url=/v5932]机甲婚[/url]，娶许多女孩，让她们都获得幸福。她赞同帝的愿望，只要自己也能成为其中一员，就愿意帮他建立后宫。她是超级天才，发明了名为“潘多拉”的装置，原本想帮助帝从互联网获取信息，但结果并不理想。她讨厌上学，即使在室外也讨厌穿衣服，还喜欢企鹅。有时她会穿着企鹅装在城里闲逛。

她对[url=/c95232]丈夫[/url]的爱称是“亲爱的”。
